name: Wizstar R1
tagline: Seedance 2.0-level product videos at a lower cost
description: Wizstar R1 is an in-house AI video model built for affordable, everyday creation. Combine up to nine reference images and videos to generate 5–15-second videos with native audio, guided by your products, characters, scenes, and styles. R1 excels at animation and 3D content and matches Seedance 2.0's usable-output rate for product videos in internal tests. Eligible members enjoy unlimited, credit-free generation, giving creators more freedom to experiment and refine their ideas.

name: Depost AI
tagline: The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand
description: Depost AI scores every LinkedIn post you've published against your own average, finds what's winning in your niche, then plans the month, writes in your voice, and designs the graphics. You approve every post, and it publishes through LinkedIn's official API. It also drafts replies to the conversations worth joining, so posts turn into leads—works in the app, or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

name: Contral
tagline: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you
description: Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

name: Periscope
tagline: Turn any work into an API
description: Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

name: Pushary Calls
tagline: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.
description: Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

name: RightFont 2026
tagline: The right font, right now.
description: RightFont 2026 is rebuilt from the ground up for a smarter, faster and more intuitive font management experience. Preview and apply fonts directly in your designs, discover fonts with on-device AI, share libraries effortlessly, and clean up duplicates with Font Insights. Built for speed, even with 200,000 fonts. Spend less time managing fonts and more time creating.

name: Espresso 27
tagline: The web editor for people who love the Mac
description: The biggest Espresso ever. A new look for macOS 27, an AI that builds across your whole site without a line of it leaving your Mac, and an editor with far more under the hood.

name: snibl
tagline: Save highlighted text from any app, then ask AI about it
description: Stop losing the things you read. Highlight text in any app on Mac or Windows and Snibl saves it with its source and context, so you can find it later. Then just ask: Snibl AI answers your questions using your own saved snippets. Software you actually own

name: Remove Silence
tagline: Cut the silence from audio in your browser, free
description: Drop an audio or video file, see every pause on the waveform, tune the threshold and download a tighter WAV. It runs on your device: no upload, no account, no watermark. For the cut video, QuellCut does it on iPhone.

name: Woomool
tagline: AI Canvas where thinking becomes tangible
description: Woomool is a AI canvas tastefully designed for ideation, knowledge management, and live collaboration. Clean, unobtrusive, and beautiful, it inspires you to focus and go deep into your thinking.

name: slay
tagline: AI composition guide camera app for iPhone
description: slay is an iPhone camera app that overlays 14 composition guides directly on your live camera view — Portrait 1, Portrait 2, Close Up, Side Chick, Travel Shot, One-Third, Two-Third, Vanishing Point, One-Point Vertex, Two-Point Vertex, Triangle 1, Triangle 2, Aerial Triangle, One-Point Aerial — each with the camera height, angle, zoom and distance to use, plus 38 built-in LUTs, so photos are framed and post-ready without editing.

name: ChickyTutor
tagline: A language tutor that knows you better daily. Now on iOS
description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with our new iOS app for iPhone and iPad. Talk face to face with your AI language tutor, answer out loud, get gentle feedback when something needs fixing, and try again straight away. You can pick your language and level, follow guided Journey chapters in supported languages, and keep your practice synced across iPhone, iPad, Android, and the web. Try it at https://www.chickytutor.com/mobileapp

name: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP
tagline: Your company's words, assembled into a book
description: Prosed AI is now for businesses. Your team has already published the ideas. Prosed AI assembles them into a non-fiction book inside your assistant. The Source Map and review packet help reviewers focus on the joins. Bring a body of work, not just an idea. AI-assisted bridges are marked for review. One book: $299, once. Free until the outline. $149 until Mon Nov 30

name: Onset
tagline: AI reviews, titles and thumbnails for YouTube creators
description: Onset reads your own YouTube Analytics and reviews each upload 48 hours after it goes live, then drafts titles in your voice and thumbnails in your channel's style. Read-only: it never posts. We're letting creators in from the waitlist, a few at a time.

name: gpyou
tagline: The OpenRouter for compute for the cheapest GPU in stock
description: One CLI for GPU clouds worldwide. gpyou rents the cheapest GPU in stock, moves to the next offer when one is sold out, and bills per second from prepaid credit. Run containers, fine-tune, serve models or a coding model of your own.

name: Ploid
tagline: People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles
description: Ploid is a people search engine with a living index of over two billion people. Search by role, company, skills or location, get up to 150 results per request, and merge someone's professional, social and personal sites into one Superprofile. Agents can reason over posts, photos and talks, not just database fields. Available as API, CLI and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor.

name: Arbitrica
tagline: Agent that finds hidden prices & fights pricing algorithms
description: Arbitrica is an AI agent that detects the world’s lowest price for anything online, starting from hotels globally. The price we're shown is the result of which country we search from; what phone we use; what time we look at... Behind this are pricing algos designed to maximise revenue from every person. Arbitrica gives people an agent that fights back. It wakes up when you are about to pay, searches from 195 countries, finds the lowest price on Earth, and prepares everything checkout ready

name: Spark AI
tagline: AI-native permitting & diligence services for data centers
description: Will that data center actually come online? Spark offers AI-native services built on a permitting intelligence platform: agents research 20,000+ jurisdictions, and an expert reviews every deliverable. Used by NextEra, Prologis, Intersect (Google), and others with a combined 200 GW pipeline. Three services: Stakeholder Intelligence (who decides, how they voted), Permit Matrices (which permits, from whom, timelines), and Project Diligence (risks from regulation, utilities & power, competition).

name: Form Action Store
tagline: Discover, create and grow with powerful digital tools.
description: 💸 Build your online business and unlock new opportunities! 📊 Digital training: DSA, EML & CYL 🚀 Learn social media marketing and online business strategies. 🔥 Beginner-friendly resources to help you take action. 👇 Start building your digital future today!

name: Botric
tagline: Invisible in AI Search? Get your brand into AI answers
description: Track and improve your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and more. Monitor mentions, citations, and competitors, and create optimized content with Botric's content agents to increase your chances of being recommended by AI.
